purpose: Bounded adversarial review of the exploratory state-routing interpretation; not a treatment run or outcome.
major_objections: The taxonomy is post hoc and cannot be validated on the same six blocks used to invent it.
The current routing signature collides across histories with contradictory exact winners; actionability features are proposed but unmeasured.
The treatment was not shown to be behaviorally engaged; VLIW agents could derive the target from the checker and the study lacked a positive sensitivity control.
recommended_next_test: Freeze features blind to outcomes, then run a causal-use decision probe with known answers, evidence citations, and a positive control before funding full chains.

budget_accounting.note: The direct review was not a Dungeness run, so the authoritative Dungeness reservation ledger was not mutated; this record prevents the spend from being omitted from study-wide reporting.
